claim_boundary: Three cases currently support the persistent-local-source headline. The result does not establish an all-operator predictor or full-parameter precision comparison.
conclusion: Local RMS does not separate directional formation in the 32-row sample. Phi final-norm source persistence greatly exceeds a five-seed repeated matched random null, but the same endpoint is diffusive on a second reachable carrier. The defensible property is therefore temporal persistence of an endpoint-mediated effective update on a declared carrier, not model-wide directionality.
